entries.msgstr: Fought in the First World War as a division commander of the Red Army. He became popular in Russia at that time thanks to the novel Chapaev by Dmitry Furmanov. He still frequently appears in movies and anecdotes.
Born into the family of a seasoned military officer, she decided to follow in his footsteps. Do not be misled by her cute face—she is a real soldier who knows her duty very well.

We do not know a lot about his past, but there is definitely a dark story he wants to forget—that is why he joined the tank forces. Well, we should respect his privacy. He does his share, so let him be.

A successful jazz musician and a saxophone god. He once bet that he would give up everything to become a soldier, and that is exactly what happened. He waits for the end of the war to claim his reward and continue his career in showbiz.
He dedicated his life to being a soldier and made tremendous progress. The U.K. allowed him to fulfill his military potential, and he was even awarded the Order of British India of the second class.
A British engineer sent to Australia to consult the local specialists on manufacturing the Sentinel tanks. When tank production stopped, he settled in Brisbane.

He is a reticent and grim fighter; however, he knows his duty well and shows top efficiency on the battlefield. His comrades have a wholesome respect for him and say they shudder to imagine what inhuman thoughts lie behind that mask.
An old-school German officer, experienced and well-trained. Irreproachable in carrying out his line of duty. Of Nordic character, self-possessed. Single. No discrediting liaisons.

Commanded a Saint-Chamond tank during WWI. In one of his battles, the enemy artillery damaged his vehicle. Lambert ordered the crew to evacuate, but refused to abandon the tank himself saying "There can be only one."
Born in Marseille, Audrey joined the French Resistance and was assigned to the tank forces when France was invaded. She wears an axe for close combat, which discourages enemy attacks.

He knows the principles of Bushido and follows its teachings rigorously. Though his reasonable obsession was rather strange to his comrades, they agree unanimously that he is the most honest and reliable soldier.

"Not every man can have wisdom. Stupid people have to exist too, because if everyone were wise, then there would be so much good sense in the world that every other person would be driven crazy by it.&zwnbsp;"
Before recruitment, he had been a professional footballer, so is well-disciplined and has a lot of stamina. A real team player.
He graduated from the Polish Artillery School in Chrząszczyżewoszyce (powiat Łękołody) and started service in the armored corps by coincidence.
A true Norseman: hardened, persistent and committed. He dreamed about joining the Swedish Navy because of his genuine love of sea adventures (especially around the shores of Britain).

He had a very strict and ascetic upbringing. Since childhood, he lived in an atmosphere of ultimate discipline, which is why the army was a good fit. He is efficient, hard-working and reliable. A true comrade.

A French army general and statesman who led the French Resistance in WWII and later became the President of France. De Gaulle resisted the very idea of surrendering France to the foe and fought hard to put an end to the occupation.
Life is strange and full of twists and turns. And now Her Majesty's former gardener commands the crew to fire at enemy vehicles. If you want to know his story, ask him in one of the Irish pubs.

An expert tanker with a smooth voice who you might remember from either your time at the Tank Academy or one of the many occasions he was found belly up on the battlefield. Even if you don't, make sure to check him out!
He knows the specifics of all vehicles and maps. He has learned the game mechanics perfectly. A talented strategist and excellent tactician. Well, that's what he says anyway.
Once a celebrity, he gained considerable tank handling expertise. Now retired, he puts all his knowledge into practice.
The alpha and the omega that decides the fate of your shells. You'd better treat them with some respect, and perhaps your next shot will be more successful.
Always the first one to move out and jump into action, because he hates having to catch up.
Do you see what I see? What exactly have we been eating today?

Marshal of Armored Troops, twice awarded the title of the Hero of the Soviet Union. His troops played a critical role in the Battle of Moscow, the Battle of Kursk, and the Battle of Berlin, as well as other significant battles during WWII.
A former New Orleans policeman and canine officer. Monotonous work made him resign and go looking for adventure. Fortunately, his old army buddies helped him find some interesting work.

One of the most influential generals during WWII. He commanded the U.S. troops in the Mediterranean, during the Allied attacks on Sicily, and in Normandy. As a tough military leader, he demanded strict discipline from his soldiers.
A driver of Abraham Turtle's Grip team.

A driver of Vitaliy Olenenko's Clutch team.

A Soviet commander of the tank and combined arms troops as well as two-time Hero of the Soviet Union. He participated in many military operations, including the Battle of Kharkov, the Battle of Kursk, and the Battle of Berlin.

This astronaut wears one of the first pressure suits, ensuring safety under acceleration, providing protection against drops in pressure, and supplying enough oxygen for respiration. This suit was developed in the U.S. in the mid-1930s.
This cosmonaut wears the SK&zwnbsp;-&zwnbsp;1 suit, designed specially for the crews of the Vostok spacecrafts. It was used during the first manned spaceflight on April 12, 1961.
This cosmonaut wears the Berkut suit that comes with an integrated life support system, used during the first ever spacewalk on March 18, 1965.
This astronaut wears the A7L suit, which NASA used for manned space activities and during Apollo 11's Moon landing mission in July 1969.

This astronaut wears the ACES suit (Advanced Crew Escape Suit) that was used by American Space Shuttle crews for launch, docking, undocking, and landing. It is unsuitable for extravehicular activities.
This cosmonaut wears the Orlan, a space suit for extravehicular activity. It was used for the first time on December 20, 1977, and its modified version is still worn by cosmonauts on the ISS.
Don't let the mask deceive you: DezGamez is going to party hard, and he's even brought a few surprise gifts for the enemy team.
"But I'm nine now! What could possibly happen to me on the Moon in the 22nd century?&zwnbsp;"
Decked out in military-grade party gear, Mailand is here to make sure the birthday celebrations get as explosive as possible.
Who needs luck when you've got confidence instead? Cygan is all set to make every birthday battle one to remember.
Party-ready style, tournament-level confidence. Dakillzor is celebrating the only way he knows how: by winning.
Good vibes only, and maybe just a little extra luck on the reload. Eekeeboo is here to celebrate big!
Ready for a royal birthday rumble? QuickyBaby is, and he's about to make sure everyone knows who's king of this party.
Rocking up to the celebrations with his favorite hoodie, an explosive cupcake, and no time for bad RNG, MouzAkrobat is here to make every battle a party!
The glittering gold tux speaks for itself: NewMultiShow has important birthday business to attend to, and nothing's going to stop him.
Crew skin? Oh no. This is a certified Skill4ltu banana skin! Load in, have fun, and let the banana magic do the rest.
Birthday mode: On. Cake: Secured. Party hat: Equipped. Goose is ready to roll out and make the enemy team part of the celebrations.
He's cool. He's confident. He's bringing the style. Orzanel is deadly serious about making every battle a celebration.
Fresh out of the jar, AwesomeEpicGuys are rolling in to the birthday celebrations as a pair of pickles. Expect crunchy plays and some trademark cucumber chaos!
A commander on the international team of the Miracle spaceship, which has successfully reached Mars.
An astronaut on the international team of the Miracle spaceship, which has successfully reached Mars.
A medic on the international team of the Miracle spaceship, which has successfully reached Mars.
A research engineer on the international team of the Miracle space ship, which has successfully reached Mars.
A flight engineer on the international team of the Miracle spaceship, which has successfully reached Mars.

Once a talented young researcher, Ermelinda followed in her evil father's footsteps, inheriting the horrific von Krieger family legacy. An outstanding scientist, she sadly put her skills to the creation of the ultimate doomsday weapon—Hyperion—that, unless stopped, has the power to change the very principles of modern warfare and turn whole countries to dust.
A military interpreter and former ranger whose trained caution and intuition helped the entire crew avoid problems during the operation many times.

Skipped college and ended up at the Spandau military barracks. During combat training, he invented the &zwnbsp;Spandauer Supersonic Slap&zwnbsp;, allowing him to split his opponents in half with a hand movement. Awarded three times before he turned 18.

"Nature gifted us electricity, but I'm the only one who could realize its infinite power, control it, and put it into use. Nobody believed me, and some people even laughed at me, but who's laughing now, you talentless skeptics?&zwnbsp;"

A retired tank ace and current physics professor who was invited by his former battlefield comrades at headquarters to join the Harrier Squad. Now the success of the entire operation rests on his shoulders, a fact that Command constantly reminds him of.
marty_vole's in the crew, and you know what that means: big laughs, big wins, and a trail of birthday destruction.
This is the guy who stole Christmas from World of Tanks players by yoinking hit points from the enemy team. Muhahaha!
With festive cheer, the crowds draw near, to raise their glass to the holiday near! The sound of drums, and festive fun—the phenomenally phenomenal Goose is here!
You better watch out, because he's seen your chat history and knows if you've been naughty or nice this year.
Hüter des RNG und Beschützer der Paid Actors - der Hailand kommt und beschert euch gute Gefechte!
It's finally Awesome Epic Christmas again and you better be good, and you better watch out, because the MerryJollyBoys are in town tonight!
The time of year to break out the big boomsticks and your favorite red jacket, and sing festive tunes with tanks.
Dak the halls with DPM and glory, lalalala, FrostyDaki!
We're already on the naughty list—might as well have some fun!
Fantastycznych świąt, pełnych radości i szczęścia oraz sukcesów na polu bitwy życzy wasz dowódca-Multi!
He is old, he is fat, not fully grey yet, but working on that. Dashing through the snow with his massive rear, Orzanel is here to see who's been good this year.
Święta to czas kiedy możecie napchać brzuchy, spędzić czas z rodziną i pograć w gierkę. Uśmiechajcie się jak najwięcej.
Marťa Claus je skvělým dárkem do tvojí vánoční garáže! Užij si hlášky!
Ho-ho-hold onto your eggnog, because commander eekeeboo is about to sleigh the battlefield, full of holiday cheer and with a twinkle in his eye!
Weihnachtszeit, sag allen Bescheid, Sankt NikoMouz macht sich Gefechtsbereit! Feuerfrei für unsere Weihnachtszauberei!
One of the best tankers under Damon Kilmore's command, as well as his old surfing buddy. Together, they came here to defeat enemies and master their surfing skills. But they're out of ocean now.
A Chief Power Engineer from special military unit 1138 who was assigned by Command to "&zwnbsp;field test&zwnbsp;" the equipment.
One of the best engineers from the expeditionary squad. He can easily get a hopeless pile of metal back on track, but it is better to prevent breakdowns than repair them.
"Tomorrow, we refuel and head for the planet Bluk. That means...today, we kick back and relax..&zwnbsp;"

That Dog has a talent for always getting into the thick of the action. Sometimes this pooch makes some very intense events happen, while staying doggedly chill (a random “Oink” coming out doesn’t count). Therefore, That Dog is a natural-born tank commander, who never ever chews on his seat because he has always been a good boy. Help him realize his full potential!
A close friend of Angela's father, he's a technical engineer who is constantly searching for better design solutions to upgrade his vehicle for the battlefield.
"Ah! This is simply outrageous! If cows are going to fly, then the cosmos is no longer the place for me.&zwnbsp;"
